label.summary: These claims demonstrate commitments to supporting civil society organizations, including legal systems, media groups, and non-profits like churches and community groups. Both Democratic and Republican platforms express this support, though with differing focuses on enforcement versus protection. The DSA focuses on activist collaboration to support worker justice.
label.title: Civil Society and Non-Profit Organizational Support

claims.claim_text: Commitment to continue to support the development of judiciary, legal systems, media and civil society organizations.
Commitment to consistently look for opportunities to work with activists in communities of color.
Commitment to continue to emphasize action over rhetoric regarding AIDS.
The national leadership and staff will work to bring together religious, labor, student, environmental and community activists to build a national campaign to achieve justice for Wal-Mart workers.

Commitment to fight for full funding and full staffing of the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission and other civil rights enforcement agencies so they can do their job of ensuring that America lives up to its creed of equal rights and equal opportunity for all.
Commitment to extend similar protections to non-profit organizations—churches, civic and community groups, and the volunteers who sustain them.
